description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Speaks a segment ad's script over the silent draft generate_segment_ad rendered (`contentId` = its resultContentId; pass the same `segmentId` and edited `beats`). Voice: `{ kind: "stock", stockVoiceId }` (default openai/tts-1:onyx) or the owner's `{ kind: "clone", cloneId }`; the brand pronunciation list is applied. No captions are added (the ad already shows each beat). A script too long for the ad is refused with speech_too_long (the voice is never sped up): shorten a beat. Costs the usual voiceover Embers (charged when queued, refunded on failure). Saves a new voiced draft; nothing is posted.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/video-studio/segment-ads/voice.)

beats.description: The beats used for the render, if they were edited.

contentId.description: The silent draft: `resultContentId` of the segment-ad render.

fallbackStockVoiceId.description: Clone only: the stock voice to use if the voice server is down.

segmentId.description: The segment the draft was made for.

voice.description: `{ kind: "stock", stockVoiceId }` or `{ kind: "clone", cloneId }`. Default: the default stock voice.

name: voice_segment_ad
title: Voice a segment ad
